ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (7) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Большая медведица» (Bol'shaya medveditsa) is 'the Great Bear' (Ursa Major, whose seven bright stars English calls the Big Dipper), and «ковш / ковшик» (kovsh / kovshik, 'dipper / small dipper') is 'dipper' throughout, avoiding 'little dipper', which in English names another constellation. «Странник» (strannik) is 'wanderer', and the attribution «С английского» (S angliyskogo) is 'From the English.'
